row_level: no clinical/deflection register in assistant text

real_source_registry.name: empathetic_dialogues
real_source_registry.license: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (upstream EmpatheticDialogues; mirror is tagged Apache-2.0)
real_source_registry.notes: The standard empathy benchmark. Uses a parquet mirror because facebook/empathetic_dialogues is script-only and no longer loadable with datasets>=4. 32 emotion labels available for filtering.

real_source_registry.name: esconv
real_source_registry.format: 1 row = JSON string: dialog[{text, speaker(usr/sys), strategy}], emotion_type, problem_type
real_source_registry.maps_to: SFT (multi-turn) + DPO; strategy labels usable for eval
real_source_registry.notes: Human-to-human emotional support with helping-skills strategy annotations (Question/Restatement/Reflection/Affirmation...). Closest register to the loveAI companion of anything public.

real_source_registry.name: counsel_chat
real_source_registry.format: 1 row = 1 Q/A: questionText, answerText, topic (therapist answers)
real_source_registry.notes: Licensed-therapist answers: valuable realism on relationship topics, but the register is clinical, so the quality gate drops referral/diagnosis boilerplate before it reaches training.

real_source_registry.name: synthetic_persona_chat
real_source_registry.notes: Synthetic (LLM-generated, Google) but explicitly *persona-conditioned*: trains the model to hold a persona while chatting. Permissive license and it covers the small-talk gap the emotional corpora miss.

real_source_registry.name: soda
real_source_registry.format: 1 row = social dialogue (list of alternating utterances) + relation label
real_source_registry.notes: 1.5M short social dialogues -- the antidote to a companion that can only respond to distress. Only a small sample is used (default 800) and it is streamed with a bounded shuffle rather than downloaded (the train parquet is ~700 MB).

real_source_registry.name: mental_health_therapy
real_source_registry.notes: Permissively licensed and long-form; likely GPT-3.5-generated rather than human.

real_source_registry.name: therapy_multiturn
real_source_registry.notes: Multi-turn companion-style therapy dialogue. Uploader states no license -> opt-in only (not in the default build).

real_source_registry.name: relationship_advice
real_source_registry.notes: The only source here with *human* preference labels: it gives DPO pairs that contrast two real replies instead of a real reply against a template. Small (400 rows) and license-unclear -> opt-in.
